hero.headline: Psychiatry Near Clayton, Missouri
hero.intro: A lot of our Clayton-area patients work for employers — law firms, the county, companies headquartered downtown — whose health plans run through UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield, or Cigna. Angela Jones, PMHNP is in-network with all three, which means medication management without the out-of-network math.

whyLocals.heading: Why Clayton Patients Choose Us
whyLocals.paragraph: Most of Angela's appointments are telehealth by default, which works well for Clayton professionals who can take a 30-minute medication check from their desk instead of losing half a day to a drive and a waiting room. John Gransbach sees patients in person at our office, about 5–8 minutes from downtown Clayton, for anyone who prefers a face-to-face evaluation.

treatmentSection.intro: Here's what psychiatric care looks like, whether you're walking over from a Clayton office or logging in from home:

services.name: Psychiatric Evaluation & Medication Management
services.description: A thorough initial evaluation and ongoing management for depression, anxiety, ADHD, bipolar disorder, and other conditions.

services.name: Buprenorphine (Suboxone) for Opioid Use Disorder
services.description: New patients are typically seen within 1–3 days — we don't believe anyone should wait weeks for treatment that can be lifesaving.

services.name: Outpatient Alcohol Detoxification
services.description: Medically supervised outpatient detox for appropriate candidates who don't require inpatient-level care.

localFaqs.question: Does my Clayton employer's insurance plan work for psychiatry here?
localFaqs.answer: If your plan is through UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield, or Cigna, Angela Jones, PMHNP is in-network — common among Clayton-area employers. John Gransbach, DNP is out-of-network; we can provide documentation for out-of-network reimbursement if your plan offers it.

localFaqs.question: Can I do a medication check over telehealth during a Clayton workday?
localFaqs.answer: Yes — most appointments with Angela Jones are virtual by default, which works well for a 30-minute check-in between meetings. In-person visits at our Clayton Road office are available anytime you'd prefer.

localFaqs.question: How quickly can a Clayton patient start buprenorphine treatment?
localFaqs.answer: Typically within 1–3 days. Opioid use disorder is a medical emergency, not something we believe should wait for a routine next-available appointment.
